scope: Proposition 6.2 (Interior envelope) of the manuscript “Pure-Point Spectrum for the Two-Dimensional Anderson Model at Every Positive Disorder” (preprints/Pure-Point-Spectrum-for-the-Two-Dimensional-Anderson-Model-at-Every-Positive-Disorder-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 261 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 17487e3a2720b36f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 36. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For almost every fixed boundary datum there is a nonnegative function E(vV ) depending only on the true interior potentials, the fixed exterior and boundary data, and the artificial mask, such that every allowed internal configuration satisfies X d∈D |Sd,source|2 ≤ E(vV ), EV,trueE ≤ eC(1+L)C ρ. (6.30) The same integrated bound, with adjusted constants, holds under any density bounded by eC(1+L)C relative to the true product law on V . The constants are uniform in the exterior data and in all adaptive interior choices.
